items.content:
Introducing Oh-My-Hermes

It is not a harness meant to replace Hermes. Instead, if you are a Hermes Agent power builder or simply want to extract top-tier, high-quality code out of Hermes, it is an essential intelligence plugin you’ll want to install.

It comes equipped with pre-planning, sub-agent and bot execution queuing, parallel tool calling and evaluation, goal engineering and definition, excessive loop-turn prevention, per-model Hermes prompt optimization, a long-term memory system, over 110 engineering skills, agent memory cleanup skills, LLM Wiki, research tools, media file parsing, Visual QA, design capabilities, a custom TUI, and prompting skills designed to trigger tools like Claude Code or Codex.

GitHub: https://t.co/g1exHwWK5E
It is an open-source project crafted by resolving the exact friction points experienced day-to-day as a Hermes Agent user, and it has already earned the love of the community with over 3,000 stars. Installation takes just a single command, and model configurations can be easily handled via the onboarding flow or TUI.

Install Oh-My-Hermes and make your Hermes Agent faster, easier, and dramatically more powerful that is our core philosophy.

#hermes #agent

Oh-My-Hermes: https://t.co/g1e...
items.content:
If you want to supercharge Hermes with agentic memory, install this.

Oh-My-Hermes: https://t.co/g1exHwWK5E

Agentic memory can be represented in various way such as facts, decisions, representations, TTLs, episodes, and embeddings. OMH provides a long-term memory system that adds these rich labels to Hermes Agent, which natively runs on a file-based structure.

If a memory can be forgotten after two weeks, it automatically assigns a TTL (Time-to-Live). It also operates based on causal relationships, diverse interpretations, episodes, and learned insights, while handling fact-checking and versioning—all tuned to dramatically boost recall accuracy.

You don't need to worry about performance overhead either; it's built so that simply installing it instantly elevates your setup. Beyond memory, this plugin comes loaded with a wide array of skills, workflows, and coding intelligence for Hermes. Grab it, install it, and enjoy!

#hemres #memory
